content: भावुक {%a.%} [भू-उकञ्] .²1 About to be or happen. .²2 Becoming. .²3 Prosperous, happy. .²4 Auspicious, blessed. .²5 Having a poetic taste, appreciative; मुहुरहो रसिका भुवि भावुकाः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 1. 3</ls>. .{@-कः@} A sisterʼs husband (used chiefly in dramas); स्वकुटुम्बवियोगेन क्लिश्यते तव भावुकः <ls>Gaṇeśa P.</ls> (The story of Pāṭaliputra). .{@-कम्@} .²1 Happiness, welfare, prosperity; स रातु वो दुश्च्यवनो भावुकानां परंपराम् <ls>K. P. 7</ls> (given as an instance of the fault of composition called अप्रयुक्तत्व). .²2 Language full of love and passion.
